entries.text: Stock charts now show a dot for every time you bought shares, at the real price and date, instead of one dot averaged across all your purchases. You can now log a purchase against a holding you already track, or enter multiple buy dates when adding a new one
Added Tokyo, Korea, and Shanghai to Market Hours, including their midday trading breaks
Fixed Portfolio Risk Analysis sometimes giving a different score on back-to-back runs even though your holdings hadn't changed

Risk Analysis, Portfolio Builder, Deep Dive, and Company Compare loading screens no longer sit stuck at 100% while still finishing up, and the finished screen now stays visible long enough to actually see it before the result appears
Finishing a Pro upgrade now shows a summary of everything you just unlocked instead of a small easy-to-miss note, and managing your subscription now returns you to your dashboard afterward

Fixed the notifications panel and account menu sometimes overlapping instead of the first one closing when you opened the other, and fixed the notifications panel closing instantly instead of animating shut
Portfolio Builder and Deep Dive results now match the redesigned Portfolio Risk Analysis layout, with clearer sections you can expand and collapse
Upgrade prompts for Why Today, Ask Bull, Portfolio Builder, and Deep Dive now preview what you'd get with Pro, the same way Portfolio Risk Analysis's prompt already did
Why Today now shows the upgrade prompt instantly for free accounts instead of after a short delay
Loading screens for Risk Analysis, Portfolio Builder, Deep Dive, and Company Compare now show smoothly moving progress and no longer jump straight to the finished result the instant it's ready
Dropdown menus and dialogs across the app, including Settings and Notifications, now animate open instead of appearing instantly
Academy leaderboard now shows plain rank numbers for the top 3 instead of medal emojis
Removed the "Generated by Claude" labels shown under Daily Brief, Why Today, Deep Dive, and Portfolio Builder results, since sources are already listed for anyone who wants to check them
Fixed some stocks' earnings staying marked Unconfirmed indefinitely, even once the report was clearly correct
Fixed the Weekly Picks table sometimes showing blank Now, Return, and vs S&P columns even after refreshing
Fixed a stray unlabeled chart appearing in the Portfolio Risk Analysis history section
Academy courses now end with a short quiz you need to pass before the next course unlocks. If you already know the material, you can skip straight to the quiz instead of doing every lesson
The Academy path now shows a countdown for when the next new course is coming, so there's always something to look forward to
Redesigned the Portfolio Risk Analysis results screen with a clearer risk score gauge, ranked risk factors, stress test scenarios, and a trend view of your past analyses

Refreshed the upgrade prompts you see when you hit a free plan limit, with clearer benefits and pricing shown up front. Portfolio Risk Analysis's prompt also now previews what a real analysis looks like
Fixed a display bug on the Academy path where some course icons could look broken or see-through
Fixed a display glitch in Portfolio Risk Analysis history where a stray colored line could appear and your saved analyses looked squeezed together
Added a temporary lock on your account after several failed login attempts, which lifts automatically after a short wait
If You Bought Here now lets you set a custom end date instead of always calculating your return through today
Changing your password now automatically signs you out of your other devices
Fixed the Daily Brief not generating for the last couple of days
Fixed text across the app rendering in a plain system font instead of BullPen's actual typeface, which made it look softer and blurrier than intended
Increased the size of small, hard-to-read text in badges and labels throughout the app
Added a reminder to help you keep your Academy streak alive if you haven't done today's challenge yet, with an on/off toggle in Settings > Notifications
Company Compare now shows real loading progress with the bull mascot while it fetches each company's data, instead of a plain skeleton screen
Refreshed the Risk Analysis, Deep Dive, Portfolio Builder, and Explain Differences buttons with a bolder emerald style and a subtle shine effect
The Ask Bull icon in the bottom corner now fills its circle properly instead of looking small and padded
Fixed the Financials charts (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) showing periods in the opposite order from the table right below them
Fixed some stocks' dividend history showing a dividend amount from a different country's stock listing, in the wrong currency
Fixed stock peer and competitor suggestions sometimes showing unrelated companies from the wrong industry
Fixed the heatmap tooltip showing a positive dollar amount next to a negative percentage change
Fixed an issue that could cause the Daily Brief to fail to generate for some Pro users
Fixed the Risk Analysis, Deep Dive, Portfolio Builder, and Explain Differences buttons sometimes rendering invisible
Academy courses are now shown as a path — each course unlocks once you finish the one before it, instead of a flat list of everything at once
Notification settings have been reorganized and expanded. You can now turn on alerts for Financial Health Score changes, Bull's Weekly Pick, your Daily Brief, and upcoming ex-dividend dates
Asking Bull to compare companies now shows a visual comparison card instead of just a text answer
Added a hover price preview when placing an alert on the full screen chart
Added a reminder email before your Pro subscription renews and charges automatically
Ask Bull now offers supportive resources if a conversation touches on personal crisis topics
Fixed Company Compare sometimes failing to load a comparison
Fixed share links showing a generic error instead of a clear No trades yet message when appropriate
Deleting your account now also removes your profile picture
Portfolio Risk Analysis now keeps running in the background if you leave the page. You'll get notified when it's done, and it picks back up automatically if you return while it's still working
Fixed Top Market Movers occasionally showing none of your holdings up or down when it had actually failed to load your data, instead of showing an error you could retry
If You Bought Here now shows how much you gained or lost in your currency, not just the percent. Hovering over a holding's day change in My Holdings shows the same
The How this is measured section on Bull's Weekly Pick is now a set of expandable questions instead of five paragraphs shown all at once
Academy course cards now use a distinct color per course instead of every card looking the same
Heatmap and Market Mood now show a clearer message when there's no data or something goes wrong, instead of a plain error icon
Ask Bull inside the full screen stock chart now remembers your conversation if you close and reopen the panel, as long as the chart stays open
The Market Calendar's week view now uses bigger, clearer tiles with the ticker shown under each logo instead of squeezed beside it, and opening a day's full list now shows a logo for every stock too
Fixed the Last used badge on the Google sign-in button being too faint to read
The Daily Brief now shows its sources. Tap the source icons at the bottom of a brief to see and open the original articles it was built from
Date pickers throughout the app (adding or editing a holding, the Buy Here tool) now use a proper calendar dropdown with quick year and month selection, instead of your browser's plain date field
Redesigned the Market Calendar with a company logo next to every ticker, ranked by market cap so the biggest companies show first. Added new List and Week views alongside the existing Month view
Added a Recently compared quick action to Company Compare, so you can reopen a past comparison in one click instead of picking the companies again
The Pro badge now stands out more clearly on Members, public profiles, and the Academy leaderboard
Compare's Explain Differences button now shows a loading animation while it works, and the AI explanation fades in instead of popping in instantly
The Last used badge on the Google sign-in button got a cleaner, more visible design
The AI chat assistant is now called Ask Bull everywhere in the app, including the command palette and search, instead of the old BullPen AI name
Cleaned up the Discover page: the explanation for each Worth a look collection now lives in an expandable FAQ instead of always taking up space on screen
Fixed paid accounts being labeled Enterprise instead of Pro on the Academy leaderboard, public profiles, and Members
Fixed the portfolio movers card saying No data available when you simply had no holdings up or down that day, instead of saying so directly
Fixed your Financial Health Score history sometimes showing an outdated score for the current quarter instead of the latest one
Fixed the full screen stock chart's Ask Bull panel covering part of the price axis

Fixed the Market Calendar sometimes showing far fewer earnings, dividends, splits, and IPOs than were actually scheduled for a busy week, including entire days going missing. It now fetches and caches each day individually so nothing gets silently dropped
Fixed avatar upload failures showing a generic error message instead of explaining what actually went wrong, like a missing photo or a permissions issue
Stock charts now show green dots where you bought and red dots where you sold, helping you visualize your trading history at a glance. Turn it on in the Overlays section of the chart settings
The Earnings Calendar now shows recent earnings reports that couldn't be immediately verified, instead of going blank. They're marked as unconfirmed so you know they're not official yet
Added Price-to-Sales ratio to the Valuation section on stock detail pages, with automatic adjustment based on the company's sector so you can compare fairly across different industries
AI Deep Dive now uses the same ticker search you'll find everywhere else in BullPen, so you can look up a company by name or ticker and see its logo before running an analysis

Fixed the Market Calendar and Earnings this week widget showing almost nothing outside of peak earnings season. They now pull from a much wider set of tracked companies, and explain when a week genuinely has no confirmed dates yet instead of just looking empty
Fixed a recurring problem where heavy background data traffic could slow down market data across the app or cause price alerts to intermittently not fire

Added two new Academy courses on how the bigger economy moves the market: the Fed, jobs reports, inflation, and oil prices. The free course covers the basics, and the Pro course goes deeper with a hands-on tour of the Market Mood tool
The S&P 500 Heatmap now has a My Stocks view. Switch to it to see your own holdings and watchlist sized by market cap and colored by today's performance, the same way the main heatmap works
The sign-in page now shows a small badge on Continue with Google if that's how you signed in last time, so you don't have to guess whether you used Google or your email and password
Fixed Ask Bull sometimes answering about a stock from earlier in the conversation, or saying your holdings weren't enabled when you had already turned that on, if you kept chatting for a while
Fixed Google (GOOG/GOOGL) showing up as two separate tiles on the S&P 500 Heatmap. Now shown as one
Fixed the My Stocks Heatmap still showing a stock you had fully sold

Bull can now reference your holdings and watchlist when you ask about your own portfolio, so questions like "how much of my portfolio is in tech" work without you listing everything out first. This is off by default and can be turned on in Settings under Ask Bull

Redesigned the S&P 500 Sector Heatmap. Prices stream live so there is no refresh button to press, the colours now match the rest of the app, and the sector list underneath is a ranked leaderboard showing which parts of the market are leading and lagging
Fixed a problem that could make market data across the app slow or briefly unavailable when too many background data requests overlapped
Fixed the Company Compare tool showing a raw error code instead of a readable message when it could not load data. It now explains what happened and offers a retry
Fixed Company Compare showing an empty screen while loading, and its layout breaking on phones when comparing three or more companies
Fixed the heatmap tooltip labelling pre-market and after-hours prices as just "Extended" instead of naming the actual trading session
You can now report a bug or suggest a new feature right from your profile menu, no need to leave the app

The Market Calendar's timeframe options are now This week, This month, and Next month, with a full calendar view for month mode, plus the ability to page back to any previous month to look up past earnings, dividends, splits, and IPOs
The Daily Performance card on the Holdings page is now compact by default, showing a quick summary strip instead of the full month grid. Click Expand to see the full interactive calendar

Fixed the Daily Performance calendar showing blank, unexplained days on market holidays like Memorial Day or Juneteenth. Those days now show which holiday closed the market instead of looking like missing data
Fixed the S&P 500 Sector Heatmap showing a hard error message when live prices were briefly unavailable. It now falls back to the last available snapshot instead
Fixed the Financial Health history list showing a date that didn't match when the company actually reported earnings. It now shows the quarter instead, matching the chart above it

Fixed the password reset flow sometimes leaving you looking signed out right after setting a new password. The session was valid the whole time, but the page didn't know it until you refreshed manually
Fixed signing in with Google failing without any error message. You'll now see what went wrong instead of the button just resetting with no explanation
Fixed an empty gap that appeared partway down the dashboard homepage for most returning users
Fixed stock pages and some dashboard sections not loading properly when browsing without signing in
Added a self-service "Forgot password?" flow to the sign-in screen. Enter your email, get a reset link, and set a new password without needing to contact support

You can now share your portfolio's daily gain or loss as a link, right from the Holdings page. It shows a preview card with your return and a mini chart, and you choose whether to include the dollar amount or post anonymously

Added a Daily Performance calendar to the Holdings page (and as an optional homepage widget). See your portfolio's gain or loss for every day of the month at a glance, with the top contributing stocks shown when you click into a day

Completely redesigned the Market Calendar into a personalized weekly grid. See your own holdings and watchlist highlighted on each day, click into any day for full earnings, dividends, splits, and IPO details, and filter by event type
The Market Calendar now shows a company's actual reported earnings, with a beat/miss indicator, once they're out, instead of just the pre-earnings estimate

Sold Positions has moved from a card on the Holdings page into a compact "History" button, and you can now edit a recorded sale's quantity, price, or date directly instead of undoing it and re-entering it from scratch
Stock and portfolio charts now show the year in the hover tooltip when viewing a year or more of history, and the YTD tab now comes before 1Y in the range picker
Made the benchmark bars on stock pages (Profit Margin, Revenue Growth, P/E, and more) easier to read, with clear scale labels and a visible zero line
Fixed stock and portfolio performance charts showing an oversized blank gap over weekends and holidays, which made trading days look squeezed together
Fixed Google (GOOG/GOOGL) showing up as two separate entries in Market Movers and the Screener. Now shown as one
Fixed the Sell modal sometimes asking for a sale price in the wrong currency. It now always asks in USD, matching how your cost basis is stored
Fixed a fully-sold holding still showing up as a row in your Holdings table
Fixed Financial Health score history occasionally showing the wrong quarter's date
Fixed the stock pages for CTRA and K sometimes showing data for the wrong company
Fixed a stock's after-hours price briefly disappearing overnight before the next trading session started

Financial Health score history now shows exactly what changed between quarters. Expand any entry to see the score change for each of the 5 categories (Profitability, Financial Strength, Valuation, Growth, Market Risk), not just the overall total
Price Alerts: you can now add more conditions to a stock you're already tracking with a "+" button, instead of having to delete and recreate the alert
Clarified that VAT is included in the Pro subscription price shown on the pricing page, not added on top
Improved text contrast throughout the app for easier reading, especially dimmed labels and timestamps on dark backgrounds
Fixed sector and industry benchmark comparisons (the "typical for its sector" markers next to Key Numbers) that had been silently failing to update since the feature launched
Fixed prices in Holdings and Watchlist going blank if a live quote briefly failed to load. You'll now see the last known price instead, clearly marked as not live
Fixed a brief flash in the Holdings table where a price could appear under the wrong currency label right after switching your display currency, before exchange rates finished loading
Fixed "Why Today?" restarting from scratch every time a stock's price ticked while you had it open. It now lives inside the Ask Bull panel, where it opens once and stays put

Fixed the Holdings performance chart showing the wrong currency and hard-to-read abbreviated numbers (like "4.8K"). It now matches your account's currency and shows full numbers, in line with the totals above it
Fixed the main navigation bar and Ask Bull button showing up on top of the getting-started signup flow
Ask Bull's stock price answers now show the company logo, with a link straight through to that stock's page

Introducing Bull's Weekly Pick: every Monday, an AI-generated stock pick with a full, permanent public track record. Anyone can check the Track Record page to see how every past pick has done, winners and losers alike; the full reasoning behind each pick is a Pro feature

The Discover page has been redesigned around a quick market read: how the S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow, and small caps are doing today, a market mood gauge, which sectors are leading or lagging, and a curated set of names worth a look, including stocks trading cheap for their sector and ones near their 52-week highs and lows

The stock price chart has been rebuilt for smoother rendering, with a subtle pattern now marking stretches when the market was closed and the intraday tooltip showing the time of day, not just the price. The log/linear price-scale option has been removed
Fixed sector and industry benchmark comparisons (the "typical for its sector" markers next to Key Numbers) not updating for most sectors after a data refresh issue
Added an Activity tab to profile pages. See a feed of portfolio activity alongside the existing Portfolio tab
Fixed Financial Health Scores not picking up a company's latest quarterly report for many stocks, due to an intermittent data-fetching issue

You can now record selling shares of a manually-tracked holding instead of just deleting it. Sell all or part of a position, and your portfolio's performance chart keeps its full history intact instead of rewriting the past. Sold positions show up in a new "Sold Positions" list with your locked-in gain or loss, and you can undo a sale if you made a mistake
AI Deep Dive reports and the AI Portfolio Builder now keep generating in the background even if you leave the page. You'll get a notification the moment it's ready, wherever you are in the app
Added a cookie consent banner. Choose "Necessary only" or "Accept all" the first time you visit; we only use cookies to keep you logged in, no ad trackers
The Volatility (Beta) card on stock pages now shows a clearer low-to-high gauge with your stock's exact spot on it, plus a marker for its industry or sector average

Fixed sector and industry benchmark comparisons (the "typical for its sector" markers next to Key Numbers) sometimes missing or showing the wrong average. Benchmarks now compare against a company's specific industry, not just its broader sector, and are sourced from more accurate company data
Fixed the Bull mascot blending into the background when you complete an Academy lesson, making the celebration hard to see in some themes
Fixed earnings dates showing the wrong fiscal quarter, and a phantom "already reported" earnings entry appearing for some stocks that hadn't actually reported yet
Fixed Ask Bull opening the public landing page instead of your dashboard when asked to go home or show market movers
Fixed AI features (like Portfolio Risk Analysis) occasionally showing a raw technical error message instead of a normal "please try again" message

New Pro courses in Academy. Go beyond the basics with intermediate and advanced lessons on valuation, reading financial statements, portfolio risk, and researching with AI, each with hands-on practice inside the real app: filter the screener for cheap stocks, read a real company's numbers, stress-test a portfolio, and research why a stock moved
Ask Bull to build you a dividend portfolio. Say something like "build me a high-yield dividend portfolio" and Bull opens the dividend calculator already filled in with picks you can edit
The price alerts page got a visual refresh. Each stock now shows its logo, and every alert has a clear icon for its type (price target, daily move, 52-week extreme, or all-time high)
Fixed a handful of stocks showing wildly wrong figures in the screener (such as an impossible market cap) caused by a data mix-up with same-named foreign listings

Key Numbers on stock pages now tell you whether a stock's P/E, profit margin, dividend, and volatility are high or low for its sector, with a "typical" marker on each meter and a plain-language note like "Cheaper than most Technology companies"
Added plain-language explanations across your portfolio and watchlist. Hover a metric label like Unrealized P/L, Cost Basis, P/E, or a Financial Health category to see what it means
The Financial Health gauge is now easier to read. Each category is colour-keyed to its slice of the ring and you can hover any category name for a plain explanation
Crypto and commodity pages now show the same visual stats as stocks, including a 24-hour range bar and plain-language takeaways
New to BullPen? A getting-started card now greets brand-new accounts with a few first steps, and disappears on its own once you get going
The Daily Brief now shows a mini price trend next to each featured stock
Financials charts (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow) are now colour-coded and animate in. The Balance Sheet shows what a company owns versus what it owes at a glance
The stock price chart is clearer and more accurate, and its indicator legend now shows a live value for each line as you move across the chart
The screener now falls back to the last known price when the market is closed, instead of showing blanks
The Community page now features an Academy XP leaderboard
Fixed the Compare tool, and Ask Bull's company-metrics and company-comparison answers, which had stopped working after an underlying data source was retired
Fixed the activity heatmap's month labels drifting out of line with their columns, which could make a month look empty
Fixed the stock chart briefly looking empty at the very start of the trading day, before the first prices of the day come in
Ask Bull's answers are now much more visual. Health scores, prices, key stats, financials, earnings, screener results, and more now show as charts and cards instead of plain text
Ask Bull can now check a stock's recent insider buying and selling activity
When you ask Bull to add, update, or remove a holding, or create a price alert, you'll now see a clear confirmation it worked, or a clear error with a retry button if it didn't
Refreshed Ask Bull's starter prompts to show what it can really do: add a holding, set an alert, check insider activity, and removed ones that led to a broken tool
Fixed profile picture uploads failing to save

Stock pages got a big visual upgrade. Key Numbers, Earnings, Financials, and Insider Transactions now show as charts, meters, and range bars instead of plain tables, each with a plain-language takeaway
Fixed the Earnings section's "Recent Reports" almost always showing empty. Past earnings now actually appear
You can now pin your favorite stocks and assets for quick access. Pin from any stock page, then see their live prices anytime from a new button in the top navigation
The AI assistant got a friendlier new look and is now called Ask Bull, with a waving bull mascot welcoming you in
You can now hide individual cards inside Market Context on your dashboard, instead of having to remove the whole section
Highlighted terms in Academy lessons now open the full AI assistant when you ask for more, so you can keep asking follow-up questions
The 5-day stock chart now includes pre-market and after-hours price moves, so you always see the latest action
Fixed live prices sometimes failing to load on the screener, watchlist, heatmap, and stock pages
Fixed some valid stocks, like ExxonMobil, occasionally showing a "not found" page by mistake
Fixed the "Build your portfolio" prompt appearing on the wrong pages and for people who already have holdings
Ask Bull now remembers your past conversations. Open the history icon in the chat panel to pick up where you left off
The Beyond Stocks: ETFs & Crypto Academy course can now be skipped if you're not interested, without blocking later courses
More Ask Bull polish: a bigger, easier-to-read chat icon, clearer status messages while it's working, and smoother text as answers come in
Ask Bull now shows a quick one-time screen the first time you chat, explaining how your messages are used
Sign-up now starts with a few quick questions about your investing experience, risk tolerance, timeframe, and goals, so the app and AI assistant feel tailored to you right away
You can now browse past Daily Briefs and step back and forth through them, so missing a morning doesn't mean missing the brief
Added four new Academy courses: Company Fundamentals, Building a Portfolio, Dividends & Passive Income, and Beyond Stocks: ETFs & Crypto
Renamed the Reading a Stock Price course to Why Stocks Move and refreshed its content so it no longer overlaps with Reading a Stock Quote
Simplified the holdings performance chart by removing the confusing "Since Purchase" timeframe, since MAX already showed the same numbers
Sped up the stock screener's live price updates
Fixed new dashboard widgets getting buried at the bottom if you'd already customized your homepage layout
Fixed the Academy lesson-complete celebration taking several seconds to appear, and made the bull mascot easier to see
Fixed the AI assistant occasionally showing a raw technical error message instead of a plain one when it hit a rate limit
Fixed recently-viewed stocks not updating for tickers not yet in our database
Fixed the Academy welcome banner popping up at the wrong time, and added a loading placeholder for the daily challenge
Fixed Financial Health scores occasionally showing different values on different pages for the same stock
Added a new Academy course, Reading a Stock Quote, covering price, bid/ask spreads, and trading volume
The Academy daily challenge is live again with a fresh question every day
Fixed Academy sending signed-out visitors straight to the sign-in page instead of showing what they'd be learning first
Fixed the Community "Browse Members" page showing no one when you weren't signed in
Fixed the "Why Today?" explanation showing a technical error message instead of a plain one when something went wrong
Added a Why Today widget to your dashboard. See the biggest mover in your holdings and watchlist at a glance, and ask why with one click
Fixed stock pages occasionally failing to load Financials or the Revenue Flow chart on first visit, and the Financial Health score not updating after a temporary data hiccup
Added a new interactive Academy course, Reading Charts, that walks you through reading a price chart step by step
The Financial Health score now tracks history over time, with a trend indicator and a chart showing how it's changed since the last earnings report
Added Norwegian as a supported language
Added a quick "Why?" button next to a stock's price that explains what's driving today's move, powered by AI with live web search
AI features across the app, including the AI assistant, now reply in your chosen language instead of always English
Fixed notifications occasionally showing implausible price swings, and made the wording clearer
Sped up API responses across the app by skipping an unnecessary network check on requests that didn't need it
Save and reuse your favorite dividend calculator setups, with a one-click option to fill it in from your holdings
Automatic brokerage account syncing is now a Pro feature; manually adding holdings or importing from CSV stays free for everyone
Fixed pre-market price changes sometimes showing as stuck at 0%
Added the BullPen logo throughout the app and as your browser tab icon
The AI assistant can now look up any company's Financial Health score and profile, even ones not yet in our database
Fixed financial health scores occasionally showing incorrect or missing data during high-traffic periods
